scripts.build: node build-config.js && node build-copy-static.js && node scripts/minify.mjs
scripts.quality:gate: npm run build && npm run audit:paranoid && node scripts/audit-links.mjs && npm run curriculum && npm run characters && npm run actionbible && npm run actionbible:packs && npm run test:security && npm run test && npm run test:site
scripts.quality:gate:full: npm run quality:gate && npm run qa:smoke
scripts.quality:gate:browser: npm run build && npx playwright install chromium && npx playwright test tests/a11y-critical.spec.ts tests/smoke-core.spec.ts tests/calm.spec.ts tests/prayer-wall-seeds.spec.ts && npm run test:live-csp
scripts.audit:lighthouse: CHROME_PATH="/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" npx lighthouse https://www.todaysdailybattle.com --output=html --output-path=./lighthouse-report.html --view --chrome-flags='--headless' --form-factor=mobile --screenEmulation.mobile=true --only-categories=performance,accessibility,best-practices
scripts.pre-launch:full: npm run quality:gate && npm run audit:lighthouse && npm run qa:smoke
scripts.pre-launch:verify-live: npm run test:live-csp && npm run validate:prod
